_notes: Each respondent = one full TROG run = one cell (model x age x repeat). Default 2 x 4 x 4 = 32 respondents (flash-lite + flash only). Pro is off by default — expensive thinking tokens and flaky for panels; add e.g. gemini-2.5-pro or a 3.x pro id only when you intentionally want that tier. Models: Gemini 2.5 Flash/Flash-Lite shut down ~2026-10-16 (ai.google.dev deprecations); defaults follow Google replacements (3.6-flash, 3.5-flash-lite). Ability is varied only on the responder side; stimulus never altered.
